name: spawn_point
title: player.spawn_point
lead: The player's own respawn point (the block of the position), or nil for the room's. Writable; a point a pack sets needs no bed. nil clears it, a bed's point too.

usedIn.quote: player.spawn_point = vec3(20.5, 65, -7.5) -- this player respawns here
print(player.spawn_point)                 -- vec3, or nil for the room's point
